_VisuAuth: Microsoft Entra External ID config. Two distinct sections — see Program.cs for why. EntraExternal: app-only Graph CRUD (admin reads/writes the directory). EntraExternal:Web: OIDC sign-in for the End-user UI (customers sign in through the hosted Microsoft page). Populate via `dotnet user-secrets set VisuAuth:EntraExternal:TenantId ...` (and friends) — NEVER commit real values.
